name: Piperidylthiambutene
summary: Piperidylthiambutene (Piperidinohton) is a synthetic opioid analgesic drug from the thiambutene family, which has around the same potency as morphine. Piperidylthiambutene is structurally distinct from fentanyl, its analogues, and other synthetic opioids previously reported.

uses.text: If sold or obtained for the purpose of human consumption it could be considered a controlled substance analogue in some countries such as the US, Australia and New Zealand. Piperidylthiambutene has been sold as a designer drug, first appearing in late 2018.

pharmacology.en: It is thought to act mainly as an agonist at the mu-opioid receptor, the same target as morphine. This relieves pain and causes euphoria and sedation, but also slows breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它主要是 μ 鴉片受體的促效劑，作用目標和嗎啡相同。這會止痛並帶來欣快感和鎮靜，但也會抑制呼吸。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它主要是 μ 鸦片受体的促效剂，作用目标和吗啡相同。这会止痛并带来欣快感和镇静，但也会抑制呼吸。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids of this kind cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and itching, and in overdose can slow or stop breathing, which can be fatal. Regular use leads to dependence and withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類鴉片類藥物會引起嗜睡、噁心、便秘和搔癢，過量時可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止，可能致命。規律使用會導致依賴和戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类鸦片类药物会引起嗜睡、恶心、便秘和搔痒，过量时可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止，可能致命。规律使用会导致依赖和戒断症状。

fact.en: The thiambutene opioids were developed by the Wellcome company around 1950. They carry two thiophene rings, which contain sulfur, where many other opioids have benzene rings.
fact.zh: Thiambutene 類鴉片是 Wellcome 公司在 1950 年前後開發的。它們帶有兩個含硫的噻吩環，而許多其他鴉片類藥物在相同位置是苯環。
fact.zhHans: Thiambutene 类鸦片是 Wellcome 公司在 1950 年前后开发的。它们带有两个含硫的噻吩环，而许多其他鸦片类药物在相同位置是苯环。
